Name: Unrot Jack-o-Lanterns
Author: OrangeGamingSystem
Description:
[size=3]Allows the player to turn Rotten Plants back into Jack-o-Lanterns after they rot during winter.[/size]

A few things to note:
[list]
[*]The mod will only allow you to unrot jack-o-lanterns after unlocking the Jack-o-Lanterns recipe.[/*]
[*]Rotten Plants decay after 1 day if not picked up.[/*]
[*]Jack-o-Lanterns will rot if placed on any winter night, not just Winter 1st.[/*]
[*]There are two Rotten Plants, so there are actually two Jack-o-Lantern recipes. Simply use the one that corresponds to the rotten plant you have.[/*]
[/list]Installion is simple, unzip the mod and put it in your Mods folder.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
